measurements.evidence_quote: The nano-MPs used in this study ranged from 50 to 100 nm with a zeta potential of -32.0 and a zeta deviation of 11.6, as determined by transmission electron microscopy (TEM; Supplementary Fig. 1). || The size distribution and zeta potential were also determined using a dynamic light-scattering device (Zetasizer; Malvern Instruments, Malvern, Worcestershire, UK).
